text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Spring Stakes arrives. 1,800 meters is still a challenging distance for Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the Classics will be even longer. With her spirits regained, Sakura Bakushin O happily walks to the track.
